approval.scope: User-approved for local test-candidate derivation only; not approved for active runtime assignment or production promotion.

source.author: Rob Tuytel
source.note: The original is retained outside the repository; the official URL and independent SHA-256 pin the downloaded master. The provider MD5 was also checked against its file manifest.

derivative.operation: Downscale full 8192x8192 source to 2048x2048 with Pillow Image.Resampling.LANCZOS; encode lossy WebP quality=88, method=6.
derivative.colorHandling: Source is RGB JPEG with no embedded ICC profile; pixel values were resized and encoded without an ICC transform. Aurion surface materials use sRGB for base color.
derivative.mapType: baseColor/diffuse only; no normal, roughness or displacement map is included in this derivative.
derivative.note: Standalone 4m x 4m paving-texture test tile. Existing active atlas and its 1024x1024/four-512x512 contract remain unchanged. The existing UV scale of 1 repeat per 4 world units is nominally aligned; visual/material approval remains pending.
